Name: Much Shrooms
Author: Aliciyar
Description:
[i][color=#900000][size=2]Disclaimer: This mod depicts psychedelic drug use. It is not intended to endorse the use of any illicit substances in the real world.[/size] [/color][/i]

[b][size=4]Description[/size][/b]
This mod adds magic mushrooms to forage in the secret woods. Find Wavy Caps, Liberty Caps, and Golden Halos, craft them into spawn, inoculate some logs and grow lots more shrooms! 

“And then what?” you might ask…

Dry them! Cook with them! Dehydrate them! And if you fancy a trip - consume them! 

Shrooms not quite your jam? Prefer your psychedelic trips in tiny, easy to swallow squares of paper? Time to make some LSD then! - Now available to extract from ergot in Much-Shrooms 2.0.

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]To install this mod, unzip the compressed file into your mods folder. Ensure you have all required mods. Then load the game as normal.[/color]

[color=#00ff00][size=5][b]UPDATE 2.0: [/b][/size][/color][color=#d4d4d8][size=5]Lucy in the Rye with Diamonds[/size][/color]
[i][color=#00ff00]This update adds a mod to the requirements: Multi Yield Crops - You can run the game without it but rye will not drop ergot and you will have no way to get it or make LSD.[/color][/i]

[/list][size=4][b]New Crop![/b][/size]
Grow rye from seeds available at Pierre’s store. Rye occasionally becomes infected with ergot, a fungus that contains lysergic acid. 

[size=4][b]New Machine! [/b][/size]
The extractor lets you extract lysergic acid from ergot and converts it into LSD. It is a very modern, high tech machine that does the extraction, conversion, drops the LSD onto a blotter sheet and dispenses a stack of individual smiley faced tabs all in one go.

[size=4][b]New Mechanics![/b][/size]
You can now use the new items in base game machines. Dehydrate your shrooms in the regular dehydrator. (This gives you a bundle of dehydrated shrooms that you can sell. They are not consumable. To get the dried shrooms for consumption or cooking, you will still need to use the drier.) Mill rye into rye flour or put it in a keg to make rye whiskey. You can even age the whiskey in a cask to increase its value. Rye can be put into the seed maker to make more rye seeds.

[size=4][b]New Recipes![/b][/size]
There’s a new cooking recipe to make pumpernickel from your rye flour, and a new crafting recipe to make the extractor. 

[size=4][b]New Buff![/b][/size]
There is now a custom “Tripping” buff that varies with each psychedelic. Recipes last longer than the shrooms they are made from and the potency of the effects varies to reflect the potency of real life shrooms.

The Shrooms:
Each shroom has custom foraging seasons, pricing, and edibility. Each one is needed for a different recipe, so be sure to collect all three.  They will appear in their respective seasons the day after rain, storms and snow.

The Logs:
Inoculation Logs allow you to cultivate shrooms so that you don’t have to wait for them to appear in the secret woods. To craft the logs you need hardwood and ok resin. Once you have foraged a shroom you can craft it into spawn and place that in the inoculation logs. The logs will produce 4 or 5 shrooms of the same type. Each shroom type takes a different amount of time to grow. Inoculation logs grow standard quality items, so you will still need to forage if you want quality shrooms!

The Drier
The Shroom Drier takes one shroom and puts out one dried version of that shroom. Dried shrooms are needed to make the new recipes.

The Recipes
Shroom Tea is made with Wavy Cap shrooms and tea leaves. 
Shroom Chocolate is made with Golden Halo shrooms, milk, and sugar. 
Mystic Tek is made with Liberty Cap shrooms and mystic syrup. [/color]
